triage.title: Player can fly out of bounds while blocking
triage.rootCause: player.js:157 applies jump velocity without checking airborne state, allowing infinite upward acceleration while holding block.
triage.playerImpact: Player rises indefinitely (y > 10) and leaves the arena (oob), soft-locking the round because the CPU cannot reach them.

patches.replace: const jumpVel = jump && !player.jumpHeld && grounded && player.state !== 'BLOCK' ? 6.0 : curVel.y;
